items.source: Creates a new StringOperators.IndexOfBytes given AggregationExpression that resolves to the substring.
items.translation: 根据解析为子字符串的AggregationExpression创建一个新的StringOperators.IndexOfBytes。

items.source: Creates a new StringOperators.IndexOfBytes given Field that resolves to the substring.
items.translation: 根据解析为子串的Field，创建一个新的StringOperators.IndexOfBytes。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and searches a string for an occurrence of a substring resulting from the given AggregationExpression and returns the UTF-8 byte index (zero-based) of the first occurrence.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接受关联的字符串表示形式，并在字符串中搜索由给定AggregationExpression生成的子串的出现位置，返回首次出现的 UTF-8 字节索引（从零开始）。

items.source: Creates a new StringOperators.IndexOfBytes given substring.
items.translation: 根据子串创建一个新的StringOperators.IndexOfBytes。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and searches a string for an occurrence of a given substring and returns the UTF-8 byte index (zero-based) of the first occurrence.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收关联的字符串表示形式，并在其中搜索给定子串的出现位置，返回首次出现位置的 UTF-8 字节索引（从零开始）。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and searches a string for an occurrence of a substring contained in the given field reference and returns the UTF-8 byte index (zero-based) of the first occurrence.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收关联的字符串表示形式，并在字符串中搜索给定字段引用中包含的子串，返回首次出现的 UTF-8 字节索引（从零开始）。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Optionally define the substring search start and end position.
items.translation: 可选地定义子串搜索的起始和结束位置。
StringOperators.IndexOfBytes 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
